description: Debugs medium and large bugs with persistent /coe case tracking, independent multi-path root-cause investigation, and a diagnostic evidence gate before repair design.

changes: Publish the initial bug-killer skill as a new unified debugging methodology instead of patching existing debug skills.
Fuse /coe case tracking, multi-path investigation, and a diagnostic evidence gate before repair design.
Add an activation gate so the heavy workflow is reserved for medium and large bugs, repeated failed fixes, broad impact, or explicit user requests.
Require evidence to link back to predeclared predictions or diagnostic evidence-plan clauses and keep research packets schema-safe inside /coe cases.
Add case template, interaction fixtures, marketplace metadata, and validation coverage for evidence-gated repair behavior.
